flavor.phonemic_palette: old_persian (Achaemenid court register: the Xshayathiya/satrapal ladder, the paradise-garden and the royal road, theophorics on Arta- and the shifted canon-stems, flowing a/i/u vowels with long counterparts, ezafe genitive-of-relation '-ahya', spirants th/x/f and sibilants s/sh/z/c, the -aspa/-arta/-farnah/-data endings) / woodland (Iroquois/Haudenosaunee: the matrilineal longhouse-clans (ohwachira) and the Grand Council of sachems, the forest-and-lake material world, labial-sparse polysynthetic compounds, glottal stops and nasal vowels, the clan-mothers who raise and depose the chiefs)

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Aryanu — domineering martial aristocracy of the synthesis; conquest, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Aryanu are a warlike martial aristocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Aryastan and Wendaki [Conquest Aristocracy (wendaki over aryastan)]. They prize conquest, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field archers, heavy_cavalry, heavy_infantry. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
